A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we are the first to address a full MIMO self-interference cancellation problem, and we have shown that our proposed solution can handle the most general case of self-interference.

we have proposed a novel digital cancellation scheme for MIMO full duplex systems, which is capable of handling all the impairments of practical transceivers, including the effects of PA nonlinearities with memory.
we are the first to propose a nonlinear spatio-temporally digital canceller for FD MIMO transceivers.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a digital self-interference cancellation scheme can be designed which is robust to nonlinearities in both the analog and digital domains.

, by using a nonlinear spatio-tempral canceller, we can achieve a self-interference suppression level that is close to what is achievable in a half-duplex (HD) scenario, and that we can achieve this with a very low computational complexity.
the digital self-interference cancellation can be extended from single antenna FD transceivers to MIMO FD transceivers with only minor modifications to the existing digital canceller structure.
